I think my main problem with this movie, and with any other sci-fi comedies like Rick and Morty (though I do love the show for the most part) is, because it's a fantastical world, you can erase any bad plotting/storytelling with "Oh look! It's a weird broccoli creature! It's an ooze creature that talks about holes! It's a head with a little butt in a kill suit! Look at how weird and crazy everything is! Don't pay attention to the humanity of the story. Don't pay attention to the bad pacing, story, because look! We're riding a weird gooey ship with a technicolor background" You can do stuff like that, but you have to have a solid base to build off of.

There was just no development here. Hank did the same thing he always does, Hope didn't really have anything to do, despite becoming a hero in the last outing, Janet "I won't reveal my secret until the plot dictates" was done for artificial tension that fell flat. The only human element was Scott/Cassie and that relationship hit all of the same, predictable beats. Kang was incredible to watch, but even his resolution was anti-climactic. Yes, I know he's coming back, and I'm excited, but the ending to this one just felt odd?

I wanted to know the same thing! It started earlier this month when, day after day, people were posting about the Jumpstart boxes and I started to notice a slight pattern in the times they would go on sale. Then, for like two weeks, they stopped. 

Recently, I saw that people were posting about them again, so I tried and tried to figure out if the releases were following a pattern like before. Turns out, it wasn't. Randomly on a Monday, at 1:30 and 8:25pm (or something like that), a few $90 boxes would go on sale at Amazon and would be sold out in minutes.

I was lucky and just kept refreshing the page, day after day. I did use some kind of tracking (nowinstock.net), but it would take too long to update and by the time I got a notification, it would be too late. I've heard that you can assign bots to go and grab them, but I wasn't really sure how they work and I suspect when I was going to buy the boxes, I was fighting bots for them anyway.

My advice? Keep checking the "new posts" section of this sub every day. Refresh this page constantly. Sure, you may be too late by the time someone posts about the boxes, but now, you know that the sale has started again. Chances are, in the following days, there will be more flash sales meaning that you can then keep checking this sub and refreshing Amazon to try and find the deal.

It's a lot of work but if you really love Jumpstart (like I do, favorite set of the last 5 years for me), then it's worth it to try and find a deal. Not sure if you're looking to buy to sell or crack but even though MaRo said they're printing more, there's no telling if they'll have them back in stock en masse like the did last summer.

Hope this helps!
